profile.name: Armor King
profile.overview: A versatile character who thrives on whiff punishment, counter hits and a strong throw game. He has a wavedash (crouch dash, f,n,d,df) with the Dark Upper launcher, many counter-hit launchers, and a complete punishment suite from i10 upward. Tekken 8 added the Bad Jaguar (BAD) stance with Poison Mist (an unblockable that guarantees a throw on hit), an easier Giant Swing input and a mid power crush.
profile.playstyle: Poke and whiff-punish in neutral, land counter hits, and mix in throws when the opponent starts blocking. His offence is linear, so sidesteps are a real threat; respect his slow whiff recovery.
strengths: Complete throw game, similar to King
Strong pokes with good range and pushback (df+1, df+2, d+3...)
Many counter-hit launchers with good combo damage and wall carry
Complete punishment from i10 to i15+, standing and crouching
Excellent whiff punishment; Dark Upper (f,n,d,df+2) is a standout
weaknesses: Poor tracking: most offensive tools are linear
Below-average wall combos; ground throw setups are breakable
Slow whiff recovery makes him easy to punish when he misses
Fewer chain throws than King, for about half the damage

stances.name: Crouch Dash / Beast Step
stances.note: Wavedash by repeating f,n,d,df. CD.1 and CD.2 (Dark Upper) come from here; combos cancel f+3,2 into CD with ~DF.

stances.name: Bad Jaguar
stances.note: Also parries high/mid punches (Wavu). Options include Poison Mist follow-ups, BAD.2+4 throw and BAD.1,2 Heat Engager.

stances.name: Back Turned
stances.note: Round Out Kick puts him back turned.

heat: Certain throws become homing (wr2+4, f,hcf+1 / BAD.1+3, BAD.2+4, qcb+1+2)
Powered-up fire moves (ub+1, ub+1+2*, db+2,1, BAD.3,2)

keyMoves.summary: Jab: fastest standing attack.
keyMoves.purpose: Interrupt, check and stop opponents mashing.
keyMoves.use: Close range when even or slightly minus.
keyMoves.avoid: Against crouching opponents: it's a high.
keyMoves.counterplay: Duck it and punish with a ws move.

keyMoves.summary: i10 standing punisher (Wavu) and a whiff punisher.
keyMoves.purpose: Guaranteed damage after blocking -10/-11 moves.
keyMoves.use: Any -10 or -11 punish; also listed as a whiff punisher on Wavu.
keyMoves.avoid: Against ducking at neutral (first hit is high).

keyMoves.summary: Mid check with good frames (Wavu: standing mid check).
keyMoves.purpose: Safe mid poke that beats ducking.
keyMoves.use: Neutral and pressure; when opponents duck highs.
keyMoves.gamePlan: One of his core pokes ('Poke God' on Wavu).

keyMoves.summary: Concussion Hook: mid that launches on counter hit (standing).
keyMoves.purpose: Strong poke with a big counter-hit reward.
keyMoves.use: When the opponent tends to press buttons at mid range.
keyMoves.avoid: Spamming it: it's punishable on block.
keyMoves.afterHit: Plus on normal hit; on CH, combo (see Combo Lab: CH df+2 staple on Wavu).

keyMoves.summary: Dark Upper (DU): crouch-dash launcher, high. Wavu calls it his standout whiff punisher.
keyMoves.purpose: Launch whiffed moves and -10 or worse blocked moves when done quickly (i11 at the fastest).
keyMoves.use: Whiff punishing from wavedash; punishing -10 to -14 for launch damage if your input is fast.
keyMoves.avoid: Against crouching opponents (high) and when you can't execute it quickly.
keyMoves.counterplay: Ducking it, or blocking and punishing.
keyMoves.afterHit: Launch: BnB or the DU staple.
keyMoves.gamePlan: The core of high-level Armor King. Practise the motion until it's automatic.

keyMoves.summary: Hopkick: launch punisher (-15 standing/crouching on Wavu).
keyMoves.purpose: Easy launch punish and anti-low.
keyMoves.use: Punish -15 moves; jump over lows as a read.
keyMoves.gamePlan: Your most reliable launcher: use it to learn the BnB.

keyMoves.summary: Shoulder Impact: i13 standing splat (Wavu).
keyMoves.purpose: Punish -13 moves with wall splat potential; whiff punisher.
keyMoves.use: Punishing -13 moves, especially near walls.
keyMoves.avoid: In neutral: launch punishable on block.

keyMoves.summary: Dark Toll Kick: high that launches (tornado) on normal hit.
keyMoves.purpose: -16 punisher and tornado combo starter (Wavu).
keyMoves.use: Punishing -16 moves; matchup-specific punishes listed on Wavu.

keyMoves.summary: Jugular Thrust: i12 while-standing mid; CH launch (crouching).
keyMoves.purpose: -12 crouching punisher with a counter-hit launch.
keyMoves.use: After blocking -12 lows; rising from crouch against attackers.
keyMoves.avoid: Little risk; it's safe on block per frame data.
keyMoves.afterHit: Plus; CH ws2,2 has a staple route.

keyMoves.summary: Snap Uppercut: while-standing launcher.
keyMoves.purpose: -15 crouching launch punish (Wavu).
keyMoves.use: After blocking very unsafe lows.

keyMoves.summary: Fastest while-standing mid (i11): -11 crouching punisher and crouching mid check.
keyMoves.purpose: Quick crouching punish.
keyMoves.use: After blocking -11 lows.
keyMoves.avoid: When a bigger punish fits the window.

keyMoves.summary: Stomp: low poke.
keyMoves.purpose: Low damage and plus on hit.
keyMoves.use: Against standing opponents.
keyMoves.gamePlan: His low poke for the mix.

keyMoves.summary: Foot Sweep: low that launches on counter hit (shadow cutter).
keyMoves.purpose: Big CH reward low.
keyMoves.use: When the opponent presses buttons at range.
keyMoves.avoid: Against blockers: launch punishable on block.
keyMoves.afterHit: Plus on hit; CH launches (tornado staple).

keyMoves.summary: Underhanded: power low (Wavu).
keyMoves.purpose: Low with good damage that crouches through highs.
keyMoves.use: Mid-range low threat.
keyMoves.afterHit: Plus on hit; CH leads to 2,1 (mini-combo).
keyMoves.gamePlan: Low half of his mid-range mix.

keyMoves.summary: Shadow Lariat: plus on block high (Wavu).
keyMoves.purpose: Keep your turn from crouch dash.
keyMoves.use: Pressure from wavedash against standing opponents.
keyMoves.afterHit: Airborne on hit (frame data shows an "a" result).

keyMoves.summary: Bad Jaguar stance entry; parries high/mid punches (Wavu).
keyMoves.purpose: Stance with throw and unblockable options.
keyMoves.use: Mix-ups and reads.
keyMoves.counterplay: Hitting the stance with kicks or lows.
keyMoves.gamePlan: New Tekken 8 tool; adds mix-up variety.

keyMoves.summary: Poison Mist: unblockable that guarantees an unbreakable throw on hit (Wavu).
keyMoves.purpose: Mix-up/read that leads to big throw damage.
keyMoves.use: Against opponents who freeze and block.
keyMoves.avoid: When they can easily interrupt or step it.

keyMoves.summary: DDT: fast command throw.
keyMoves.purpose: Throw option up close.
keyMoves.use: Against blockers.
keyMoves.counterplay: Break it (see Move Library for break info) or crouch.

keyMoves.summary: Double Arm Swing (Giant Swing).
keyMoves.purpose: High-damage command throw; homing in Heat (Wavu).
keyMoves.use: Against blocking opponents.

keyMoves.summary: Heat Engager; -15 punisher and whiff punisher (Wavu).
keyMoves.purpose: Punish and enter Heat.
keyMoves.use: Punishing -15, whiff punishing.

keyMoves.summary: Heat Smash (Infierno Jaguar).
keyMoves.purpose: Heat finisher.
keyMoves.use: During Heat.
keyMoves.avoid: Check block frames before relying on it.

keyMoves.summary: Rage Art.
keyMoves.purpose: Armoured comeback move.
keyMoves.use: Clear reads in Rage.

lessons.title: Who is Armor King?
objectives: Understand AK's poke, counter-hit and throw game plan
Recognise his key moves' hit levels and safety
lessons.explanation:
Armor King wins with **pokes, counter hits, whiff punishment and throws**. He has strong punishment at every frame window, a wavedash with the Dark Upper launcher, and a deep throw game.

His weaknesses: **linear offence** (sidesteps beat it) and **slow whiff recovery**. As a beginner: block, punish with 2,1 / uf+4, poke with df+1, and learn the BnB from uf+4.
review: Dark Upper and b+3 are highs: they whiff on crouching opponents.

lessons.title: Essential pokes
objectives: Execute 1, 2,1, df+1, df+4, d+3 and d+1 cleanly
lessons.explanation:
Armor King's pokes have good range and pushback.

- **1 / 2,1**: fastest, highs
- **df+1**: mid check
- **df+4**: fast mid
- **d+3**: stomp, low poke
- **d+1**: crouch jab

Check each move's frame data in the Move Library.
review: df vs d diagonals are the usual failure: check the input log.

lessons.title: Armor King's throws
objectives: Perform 1+3, 2+4, db+1+2 (DDT) and uf+1+2 (Armor King Driver)
Break throws in the simulation
lessons.explanation: AK's throw game is one of his strengths. Start with generic **1+3** and **2+4**, plus fast command throws **db+1+2** (DDT) and **uf+1+2** (Armor King Driver). Advanced command throws (Giant Swing f,hcf+1, Tombstone db,n,f+2+4, Hades Drop qcb+1+2) come in Stage 4.
lessons.success: Throw inputs and breaks at the required rates.
review: Press both buttons within a couple of frames.

lessons.title: Stage 1 test: foundations
objectives: Prove you can read notation and execute AK's basic inputs
lessons.explanation: Mixed inputs and a frame-data quiz. Pass to unlock Stage 2.
review: Retry the lesson whose inputs you missed.

lessons.title: Launchers: uf+4, ws1, uf+2,1
objectives: Execute each launcher cleanly
lessons.explanation:
- **uf+4**: hopkick, -15 punisher standing or crouching
- **uf+2,1**: -15 standing launch
- **ws1**: -15 crouching launch
- **f,n,d,df+2** (Dark Upper): fastest launcher, but a hard input; it gets its own lesson in Stage 3.

Use launchers as **punishers**: they are punishable on block.
lessons.success: Inputs and quiz at the mastery threshold.
review: ws1 fails if you are still holding down.

lessons.title: First combos: counter-hit follow-ups
objectives: Land short CH follow-ups consistently
lessons.explanation:
Start with Wavu's mini-combos:

- **CH f,f,n,2 → 2,1**
- **CH f+4 / BAD.1+2 → df+4**
- **CH d+2 → ws3,1** (Heat Engager)

Use Slow mode first, then Consistency mode.
review: ws3,1 needs release-down-then-press.

lessons.title: Standing punishment
objectives: Pick the right punisher for each window
Punish in the simulation on time
lessons.explanation:
Armor King's standing punishers (Wavu):

- **-10**: 2,1
- **-12**: b+1,2, d+1+3, d+2+4
- **-13**: f+1+4, 4,3
- **-14**: db+2,3
- **-15**: uf+4, uf+2,1 (launch), f+2,1, f,F+4
- **-16**: b+3 (tornado)

A complete suite: punish everything.
lessons.success: Quiz at threshold, drill at pass rate.
review: Use the strongest punisher that fits, not just 2,1.

lessons.title: Crouching punishment
objectives: Punish lows with ws4, ws2, ws3,1, ws1 and uf+4
lessons.success: Inputs and drill at pass rate.
review: Release down and press almost together.

lessons.title: Basic neutral: poke and whiff punish
objectives: Understand AK's spacing game
Practise neutral habits in Tekken 8
lessons.explanation:
Coach advice: Armor King's neutral is about **range control**. Use df+1/df+2/d+3 at their maximum range, then backdash to make the opponent whiff and punish with f+1+4, f+2,1 or Dark Upper.

His offence is linear: if the opponent sidesteps a lot, slow down and block, then punish.

The challenge happens in Tekken 8; confirm it yourself.

items: Play 3 matches focusing on pokes at max range and blocking
Watch one replay: count how many whiffs you could have punished
In Practice, record the dummy doing a whiffed move and punish it 10 times

review: Don't throw out slow moves at close range: AK recovers slowly on whiff.

lessons.title: Stage 2 test: core combat
objectives: Punish and combo under test conditions
lessons.explanation: Pass to unlock Stage 3.
review: Check the Progress page for your most common error.

lessons.title: Bread-and-butter combo
objectives: Land AK's regular launch BnB from uf+4
lessons.explanation:
Wavu's BnB: **df+3 f+3,2~DF CD.1 f+3,2,1 T! dash f+1+2~F BAD.2+4**.

Key execution points:

- **f+3,2~DF**: right after the 2, hold down-forward to cancel into crouch dash (CD)
- **CD.1**: press 1 out of crouch dash
- **T! dash**: after the tornado, dash forward
- **f+1+2~F**: hold forward after f+1+2 to enter Bad Jaguar, then **BAD.2+4**

This app checks input order and timing only; confirm the hits connect in Tekken 8 Practice mode.
review: Use Progress → weakest transition to drill the exact step.

lessons.title: Wavedash and Dark Upper
objectives: Execute f,n,d,df+2 and f,n,d,df+1 reliably
Know why DU matters
lessons.explanation:
Crouch dash: **f, n, d, df** (forward, neutral, down, down-forward). From it: **Dark Upper** (f,n,d,df+2), a high launcher at i11 at the fastest (Wavu), and **Shadow Lariat** (f,n,d,df+1), plus on block.

Wavu ranks the wavedash and 'DU in neutral' as his most important key techs. The recognizer shows exactly where your motion breaks.
review: The n is essential: f must return to neutral before d.

lessons.title: Counter-hit tools
objectives: Know AK's counter-hit launchers and when to use them
lessons.explanation:
Wavu calls AK a 'counter-hit monster':

- **df+2**: standing CH launch
- **ws2**: crouching CH launch, safe
- **db+3**: low CH launch (launch punishable on block)
- **4,3**: CH leads to a full combo

Use them against opponents who press buttons.
review: Counter-hit tools only pay out against active opponents.

lessons.title: Whiff punishment
objectives: Punish whiffed moves within their recovery
lessons.explanation:
Whiff punishers listed on Wavu: **2,1, f+1+4, db+2,4, db+2,3, f,n,d,df+2, f+2,1, b+4,1+2, f,n,d,df+1, f,F+4**.

The simulation trains timing; range must be learned in Tekken 8.
review: Wait for the recovery; don't press during active frames.

lessons.title: Stage 3 test: reliable execution
objectives: BnB consistency and crouching punishment
lessons.explanation: Pass to unlock Stage 4.
review: Drill your weakest transition.

lessons.title: Optimized launch staple
objectives: Land the DU-start staple for max damage
lessons.explanation:
Wavu's highest-damage regular launch staple adds an in-combo Dark Upper: **f,n,df+2 df+3 f+3,2~DF CD.1 f+3,2,1 T! run f+1+2 BAD.2+4** [+66; 42]. The 4,3 version [+64; 41] is easier.

Damage figures are shown exactly as listed on Wavu.
review: If the DU start keeps dropping, use the 4,3 version in matches.

lessons.title: Wall combos
objectives: Finish combos at the wall
lessons.explanation: Wavu lists AK's wall enders: **3,4,1** [+16; 10] and **df+1,2 T! 3,4,1** [+32; 21] after a regular carry. Wavu notes his wall combos are below average, so reliability matters more than damage.
review: Verify in Tekken 8 Practice that df+1,2 tornados at your usual wall distance.

lessons.title: Advanced throw game
objectives: Execute Giant Swing, Tombstone and Hades Drop
Use Poison Mist
lessons.explanation:
- **f,hcf+1**: Double Arm Swing (Giant Swing)
- **db,n,f+2+4**: Tombstone Piledriver
- **qcb+1+2**: Hades Drop
- **f,n,d,df+1+2**: Poison Mist, unblockable; on hit a throw is guaranteed (Wavu mini-combos)

In Heat several throws become homing (Wavu). Break info for each throw is in the Move Library notes.
review: Half-circle motions: b, db, d, df, f in order.

lessons.title: Bad Jaguar stance
objectives: Enter BAD and use its main options
lessons.explanation: **f+3+4** enters Bad Jaguar (also parries high/mid punches per Wavu). Options include **BAD.1** (fast high), **BAD.1,2** (Heat Engager), **BAD.2+4** (throw), **BAD.4** (low) and **BAD.3** (power crush).
review: The stance can be interrupted: don't sit in it.

lessons.title: Defence under pressure
objectives: Block mix-ups, break throws and punish in a mixed scenario
lessons.explanation: The adaptive mixed-pressure bot uses more of what you fail. Timing and decision simulation, not Tekken 8's engine.
review: If you press into safe moves often, block twice before acting.

lessons.title: Using Heat
objectives: Know AK's Heat Engagers and Heat bonuses
lessons.explanation: Heat Engagers (Wavu): **f+2,1, f,F+4, d+2+4, ws3,1, BAD.1,2**. In Heat, certain throws become homing, CD.1+2/BAD.f+1+2 become faster, and fire moves power up (ub+1, ub+1+2*, db+2,1, BAD.3,2).

items: In Tekken 8 Practice, enter Heat with f+2,1 and land H.2+3
Land a homing Giant Swing during Heat on a sidestepping dummy
Note which Heat Engager you can confirm most reliably

review: Heat is once per round.

lessons.title: Stage 4 test: advanced play
objectives: Advanced combo and defence
lessons.explanation: Pass to unlock Stage 5.
review: Use dashboard Review sessions.

lessons.title: Scenario challenges
objectives: Correct decisions under a high-pressure adaptive bot
lessons.explanation: Set drill difficulty to Hard and pass the mixed scenario.
review: Fix your single biggest error category first.

lessons.title: Matchup preparation
objectives: Build a punishment sheet for common opponents
lessons.explanation: Wavu lists matchup-specific punishes for AK (e.g. b+3 against several characters' moves). Use the Punishment Trainer and the in-game checklist.

items: List the 3 characters you lose to most
Record 2 unsafe moves of each in Practice and find your best punish
Check Wavu's AK punisher page for matchup-specific punishes

review: Revisit each patch.

lessons.title: Final test: competitive readiness
objectives: Execution, punishment and decision-making together
lessons.explanation: Optimized staple consistency and the adaptive mixed scenario.
lessons.success: Both parts at the required level.
review: Keep doing daily reviews.
